title: Add Reading Progress
content: Create progress indicator. Container: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 h-1 bg-gray-200. Progress bar: h-full bg-blue-500 transition-all, width based on scroll position. Calculation: scrollTop / (scrollHeight - clientHeight) * 100. Update: on scroll event with throttle.

variants.simple: Create reading progress bar for articles.
variants.detailed: Create progress indicator. Container: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 h-1 bg-gray-200. Progress bar: h-full bg-blue-500 transition-all, width based on scroll position. Calculation: scrollTop / (scrollHeight - clientHeight) * 100. Update: on scroll event with throttle.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive reading progress indicator. Bar types: top fixed bar (default), bottom bar, circular indicator, sticky TOC highlight. Progress calculation: track scroll through article element specifically (not whole page), handle dynamic content height. Fixed bar: thin line at top, color customizable, optional gradient effect. Circular: floating circle with percentage or arc fill, click to toggle visibility. Table of contents: highlight current section, scroll spy for headings. Time estimate: "X min read" based on word count, optional "X min remaining". Completion: trigger event at 100%, save reading progress for logged-in users. Scroll behavior: smooth scroll to continue reading after page refresh. Partial reads: save position in localStorage, prompt to continue. Article zones: break progress into sections (intro, body, conclusion). Hide rules: hide until scrolled past hero, hide on scroll up (re-show on scroll down). Multiple articles: handle page with multiple articles. Print: hide for print styles. Accessibility: progress is supplementary info, not essential, aria-hidden if purely decorative. Performance: use requestAnimationFrame, passive scroll listener. Mobile: larger touch target for circular variant.
